description: Look up the logo of a company by its domain (stripe.com). Returns a stable URL, the brand name, a ready img tag and the brand page. variant: base (original colours), white, black, grey or dark (for dark backgrounds); recolour variants exist for SVG only. format: svg (default) or png. If the brand is not in the catalog, found is false and fallback_url serves the site favicon or a name tile.

domain.description: Company domain, for example stripe.com. A URL or www. prefix is accepted.

format.description: File format. png is a rendered 512 px image.

variant.description: Colour version. Only svg logos have white, black, grey and dark.

name: get_logo
title: Get a company logo
